install.title: Install Permacite
install.sub: Follow these 6 steps to add Permacite to Chrome. Takes less than 2 minutes.
install.download_note: Free · No account required to download
install.step1_desc: Click the button above to download the permacite-extension.zip file.
install.step2_desc: Right-click the ZIP and select "Extract All" (Windows) or double-click it (Mac). You will get a folder named permacite-extension.
install.step3_desc: In Chrome, type this address in the address bar and press Enter:
install.step4_desc: In the top-right corner of the extensions page, toggle on "Developer mode".
install.step5_desc: Click "Load unpacked" (top left), then select the permacite-extension folder you extracted in step 2.
install.step6_desc: The Permacite icon will appear in your Chrome toolbar. Click it and sign in to start archiving.
